references.applied: Keep artwork visible while editing typography; direct placement on the canvas and familiar alignment choices in the same editor.
One contextual tool area follows the current creative operation, with clear completion and history controls.

references.source: Apple · Adopting system selection UI in custom text views
references.applied: Native multiline text field retains paste, dictation, cursor, and selection rather than implementing a custom keyboard or editing menu.
Named, image-led project tiles with contextual item actions; thumbnails show actual saved artwork.
Quiet collection space and direct return to creation; separate project action menu from the large opening target.
Deleting a saved piece shows the named outcome and an immediate Undo action; failed reads preserve original files.
Avoid duplicate customizations; Create and Made share one Studio destination with contextual editing controls and no duplicate customization modal.
